title: Design a function and generate its tests
inputs: where it belongs in the codebase
steps: write a short plan: signature, inputs/outputs, edge cases
confirm the plan matches what was actually asked before writing code
write tests that cover the normal case and the edge cases named in the plan
run the tests and fix the function (not the tests) until they pass for the right reason
success_conditions: the tests exercise the edge cases the plan named, not just the happy path
the tests pass against the real function, not a stubbed one
